uutiset.t: Air India Chief Seeks to Cut $650 Million in Costs This Year
uutiset.s: Air India Ltd. is looking to cut costs by 60 billion rupees ($650 million) this financial year as its new Chief Executive Officer outlined initiatives to revive the Tata Group-owned airline, which posted a record loss in the year ended March, people familiar with the matter said.

uutiset.t: Banks Pitch CVC €11 Billion Debt for Possible Verisure Takeover
uutiset.s: Banks are offering CVC Capital Partners Plc up to €11 billion ($12 billion) in debt financing for a takeover of Verisure Plc, as the buyout firm weighs a bid to return the home security group to private ownership after a difficult year on the public markets.

uutiset.t: Homebuilder Stock Woes to Persist After Longest Slump Since 2008
uutiset.s: Homebuilders are coming up on an ominous market milestone, with stocks for the group set for three straight years of declines in the longest stretch since the subprime mortgage meltdown that led to the Global Financial Crisis.

uutiset.t: Nasdaq 100 Set for Bear Market as AI Trade Unravels at the Seams
uutiset.s: The Nasdaq 100 Index is set to fall into its first bear market in more than a year as investors dump stocks exposed to the artificial intelligence industry amid rapidly deteriorating sentiment.

uutiset.t: Deere Sees Headwinds Ahead for Farmers in 2027
uutiset.s: Deere & Co. says it expects higher sales of its biggest machines in the 12 months through October, but also sees net income of $4.5 billion to $5.25 billion, which trails the $6.1 billion average of analysts’ estimates compiled by Bloomberg. uutiset.t: Bullrich dice que reelección de Milei está en riesgo si la economía no mejora
uutiset.s: Patricia Bullrich advierte que no basta con esperar una mejora económica en 2028: antes están las elecciones de 2027. La senadora pide cambios “quirúrgicos” para impulsar a los sectores que atraviesan dificultades. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: NYC Private School to Buy Farm Previously Owned by Bankrupt Peer
uutiset.s: A private school on Manhattan’s Upper West Side is planning to purchase a 165-acre farm in the Catskills that was previously owned by its bankrupt peer.

uutiset.t: Embraer Sinks Most Since May as US Proposes Brazil Aircraft Levy
uutiset.s: Embraer SA shares fell almost 10% in São Paulo after the US proposed an additional 10% tariff on aircraft exported from Brazil.

uutiset.t: Stocks Meltdown Spills Into Unlikely Market, Sinking Carry Trade
uutiset.s: One of Wall Street’s most reliable wagers of 2026 is starting to lose its surefire status.

uutiset.t: BC Partners Buys GSE Agency With Golfer DeChambeau on List
uutiset.s: BC Partners’ credit arm has agreed to buy a majority stake in GSE Worldwide, a sports marketing agency which represents athletes such as golf celebrity Bryson DeChambeau and former NFL and MLB star Bo Jackson.

uutiset.t: Why Is Thanksgiving So Expensive This Year?
uutiset.s: Planning your Thanksgiving grocery run? You might notice a few changes in the aisles this year. uutiset.t: Nvidia Still Faces Issues That Cost $2 Trillion in Market Value
uutiset.s: The euphoria surrounding Nvidia Corp. shares following the return of Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang on Monday is wearing off as investors come to grips with the questions still hanging over the world’s biggest chipmaker.

uutiset.t: Nasdaq 100 Slumps in ‘Sell First’ Mode as AI Angst Fuels Losses
uutiset.s: The Nasdaq 100 Index tumbled for a second day, sending it briefly careening into bear-market territory, as mounting fears about over-investment in AI pummeled shares of the biggest technology companies.

uutiset.t: Dangote Refinery Said to List in Lagos on December 1
uutiset.s: Bloomberg understands billionaire Aliko Dangote’s oil refinery will start trading in Lagos as soon as next week. uutiset.t: US Treasuries Soar as Tech-Stock Losses Dent Risk Appetite
uutiset.s: US Treasuries rallied as renewed losses in technology shares sent investors rushing back into the haven trade.
